judge_consensus.error_rule: ERROR only when both cross-family judges return ERROR for the same criterion
judge_consensus.not_assessable_rule: NOT_ASSESSABLE is reported separately and never treated as PASS

chemistry_protocol.description: Audit transformation fidelity and every material, condition, and stage against the supplied protocol and source facts.

criteria.name: Transformation fidelity
criteria.question: Are substrate, product, transformation, catalyst strategy, reaction modality, and phase regime preserved without unsupported substitution?

criteria.name: Materials and stoichiometry
criteria.question: Are all reagents, catalysts, solvents, additives, concentrations, equivalents, and feed compositions chemically coherent and faithful to the protocol?

criteria.name: Condition and stage mapping
criteria.question: Are temperatures, irradiation, pressure atmosphere, addition order, stage boundaries, and reaction times mapped to flow without omitting a chemistry-critical operation?

criteria.name: Unsupported chemistry claims
criteria.question: Does the record avoid invented reactions, products, catalysts, literature claims, mechanisms, conversion targets, or unsafe chemical assumptions?

numerical_engineering.description: Recalculate all quantities and inspect every numerical representation, including intermediate and final records.

criteria.name: Units and dimensions
criteria.question: Are units, signs, bases, conversions, significant values, and dimensions explicit and correct throughout the record?

criteria.name: Liquid material balance
criteria.question: Do concentrations and liquid flow rates reproduce component molar flows, reagent equivalents, total flow, dilution, and throughput?

criteria.name: Gas basis and equivalents
criteria.question: When gas is present, do STP/inlet and pressure-temperature-corrected in-channel flows, molar flow, equivalents, holdup, and pressure basis close and remain distinct?

criteria.name: Residence-time closure
criteria.question: Do reactor volumes, cumulative stage flows, liquid holdup, EBRT/contact-time definitions, per-stage times, and total residence time close everywhere they appear?

criteria.name: Pressure, temperature, and phase
criteria.question: Are BPR, absolute/gauge pressure, vapor-pressure margin, temperature, boiling/phase assumptions, and depressurization physically and numerically consistent?

criteria.name: Transport and heat calculations
criteria.question: Are geometry, pressure drop, Reynolds/Peclet/Damkohler values, mixing, mass transfer, heat transfer, productivity, and startup waste calculated from the authoritative design using defensible assumptions?

process_inventory.description: Audit the executable process topology and every inventory assignment across all representations.

criteria.name: Topology completeness
criteria.question: Are feeds, pumps/MFCs, mixers, reactors, controllers, pressure control, separators, quench, collection, and waste connected in the correct executable order?

criteria.name: Inventory existence
criteria.question: Does every named equipment ID exist in the supplied inventory, with no invented hardware, material, reactor, mixer, pump, controller, or accessory?

criteria.name: Capability feasibility
criteria.question: Are flows, volumes, IDs, materials, temperatures, pressures, wavelengths, and serial/parallel topology within the declared capability limits?

criteria.name: Cross-record equipment consistency
criteria.question: Do final parameters, topology, inventory allocation, instrument manifest, stage tables, and engineering calculations assign the same equipment and settings?

criteria.name: Preparation and work-up
criteria.question: Are feed preparation, order of addition, compatibility, startup collection, steady-state collection, quench, separation, work-up, and analytical qualification sufficiently specified?

safety_operations.description: Audit chemistry-specific hazards and operational controls from preparation through shutdown.

criteria.name: Hazard recognition
criteria.question: Are all relevant chemical, thermal, pressure, gas, peroxide, azide, catalyst, solvent, and incompatibility hazards identified?

criteria.name: Preventive controls
criteria.question: Are hazards converted into concrete containment, ventilation, purge, interlock, pressure-relief, temperature, inventory-minimization, and compatibility controls?

criteria.name: Startup and shutdown
criteria.question: Are leak testing, priming, purging, transition to reactive feeds, steady-state criteria, normal shutdown, emergency shutdown, depressurization, and flushing ordered safely?

criteria.name: Quench and waste
criteria.question: Are outlet depressurization, gas venting, quench, reactive-residue destruction, waste segregation, and collection pressure handled safely and explicitly?

criteria.name: Safety-disposition consistency
criteria.question: Do unresolved hazards and failed engineering checks agree with confidence and SCREEN/BLOCK/EXECUTE disposition, without an unsupported safety override?

evidence_uncertainty.description: Audit provenance, assumptions, source use, and uncertainty throughout the complete record.

criteria.name: Protocol/source provenance
criteria.question: Are protocol facts and held-out source facts represented accurately and traceably without source invention or selective contradiction?

criteria.name: Assumption labeling
criteria.question: Are estimated properties, kinetic assumptions, transport coefficients, conversion targets, analogies, and model inferences explicitly distinguished from measured facts?

criteria.name: Evidence relevance
criteria.question: Are cited analogies and references relevant to the same chemistry, modality, phase behavior, equipment regime, and decision being supported?

criteria.name: Uncertainty calibration
criteria.question: Are unknown kinetics, scale-up risks, parameter ranges, failed checks, confidence, validation experiments, and disposition calibrated to the available evidence?

system_consistency.description: Audit the complete design history and determine whether every subsystem closes to one authoritative design.

criteria.name: Single numerical authority
criteria.question: Do proposal, council candidates, final realization, calculations, topology, inventory assignment, recipe, validation, and final design identify one authoritative numerical design or clearly mark earlier values as rejected?

criteria.name: Revision trace
criteria.question: Are material changes from initial proposal through deliberation to final realization documented with reasons and correctly propagated to every downstream artifact?

criteria.name: Validation truthfulness
criteria.question: Do validation PASS/FAIL states accurately reflect the underlying values, warnings, inventory assignments, safety findings, and unresolved contradictions?

criteria.name: Decision quality
criteria.question: Are alternatives and trade-offs evaluated against chemistry, engineering, inventory, safety, evidence, and experimental objective before final selection?

criteria.name: Record reproducibility
criteria.question: Can a trained independent reviewer reconstruct the final experiment and every important calculation from the available record without choosing between conflicting values?
